text: {"overall_winner":"B","qualities":[{"evidence":"longer, multi-paragraph argument with repeated reasons and examples","quality":"development","description":"This captures how fully an essay elaborates its main idea with supporting points rather than just stating it."},{"evidence":"clearer line of reasoning from honesty to trust to consequences","quality":"organization","description":"This captures how well ideas are sequenced and connected to build a coherent argument."},{"evidence":"more varied transitions like \"because,\" \"if,\" \"when,\" and \"so\"","quality":"cohesion","description":"This captures how effectively the writer links sentences and paragraphs with discourse connectors."},{"evidence":"sentences such as \"if you lie all the time people will turn their backs on you\"","quality":"sentence control","description":"This captures stronger ability to form complete, readable sentences despite errors."},{"evidence":"phrases like \"you shouldn't be trusted by anyone\" and \"so be honest all the time\"","quality":"assertive expression","description":"This captures a stronger ability to state claims directly and maintain a persuasive tone."},{"evidence":"comparatively fewer run-on fragments than Essay A","quality":"readability","description":"This captures how much easier the writing is to follow because the sentence boundaries and flow are more controlled."}]}
